notes: Each eval runs in a sandbox from tests/make_fixture.py; tests/grade_eval.py checks the sandbox state mechanically. Eval 3 is pre-dehydrated (setup: apply) and exercises the rehydrate skill.

evals.name: clean-out-older-than-a-week
evals.prompt: i've got way too many claude sessions and worktrees hanging around and my disk is filling up. close out everything that's older than a week but don't lose any of my work
evals.expected_output: Runs plan, summarizes it (closes, removals, holds with reasons), runs apply --yes, reports free disk before/after and anything not done, points at index.md and /rehydrate.
assertions: stale worktrees dirty, clean and unpushed are removed and each has a manifest record with a verifying bundle
kept and held worktrees (recent, busy, locked, nested, ignored-big, hermes) still exist
main branch and every wt-* branch are unchanged; nothing was pushed to origin
claude rm was called for b0000001 and b0000003 and never for b0000002 or b0000004
final reply names the held worktrees with reasons and mentions rehydrate

evals.name: preview-three-days-no-changes
evals.prompt: before you touch anything, what would get closed if i used a 3 day window instead of a week? just tell me, don't change anything
evals.expected_output: Runs plan --days 3 only, reports counts and holds, makes no changes, offers to apply.
assertions: no worktree was removed and no manifest was written
the fake claude binary was never called with stop or rm
the reply states how many sessions and worktrees would close

evals.name: rehydrate-widget-session
evals.prompt: last week you cleaned up my old sessions. i need back the one where i was fixing the widget, with all my uncommitted changes
evals.expected_output: Uses list widget, rehydrates the matching record, worktree restored on wt-dirty with modified/untracked/ignored files, gives the claude --resume command.
assertions: the dirty worktree exists again on branch wt-dirty
a.txt holds the modified content, new/untracked.txt exists, gone.txt is absent, secrets.local is restored
the transcript for session ...0001 exists under CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/projects

evals.name: dehydrate-one-worktree-only
evals.prompt: can you dehydrate just the 'clean' worktree in the app repo? leave everything else alone for now
evals.expected_output: Runs plan/apply with --only clean; only that worktree is removed and recorded.
assertions: the clean worktree is removed and has a manifest record
the dirty and unpushed worktrees and the leftover dir still exist
